purpose: Map the v81 public family-housing demand/friction miss into permanent regressions in the SAME Stödassistenten learning system.

mappings.product_miss: The public general person flow collects children and housing-pressure answers but does not use them in getRows, even though v80 added canonical family housing-benefit truth and learning coverage.
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Reuse the already-collected general-flow facts in the existing person result pipeline. Surface the same canonical family housing-benefit candidate only when children=yes, housing=yes and money is pressured; preserve first-day unemployment or existing a-kassa regime actions ahead of it; keep sv/ar/fa parity and fail closed for 2027 material claims.
mappings.truth_boundary: The public candidate is navigation, not an eligibility decision. Canonical family housing truth stays NEEDS_REVIEW with no AI-verified material fields. Current Försäkringskassan primary sources are required for eligibility, amount, application, child-residence, income-period and future-rule claims.
